text:
ana: Heads-up 1: Datadog wants a co-branded observability bundle on GCP Marketplace: traces + curated dashboards + quick-start OTEL. Need to coordinate tech assets + marketplace metadata this sprint.
matt: Nice. Do they want any special billing or metering hooks for marketplace installs?
rachel: Marketing needs the official 1-sentence product blurb, 2-3 bullet benefits, and a hero dashboard screenshot for the listing. Deadline they gave: Apr 14.
omar: From engineering: we'll need to provide OTLP + Datadog exporter config, a dashboard JSON, and a tiny sample app that emits traces and metrics. Also docs on span keys & service naming.
evan: For the sample app I'll put together a Node example that calls the API and emits model_id and request_id as span attributes. Keep it under 50 lines.
sdk-bot: reminder: existing rdw-otel-snippets repo contains exporter helpers and a readme. Link: https://git.internal/rdw/rdw-otel-snippets
matt: For the dashboard, let's include panels for: model latency pctiles, request rate by model, token-cost proxy (tokens/sec * cost_per_token), and sampling rate. Also an installable import JSON.
rachel: Legal asked for a short liability blurb for the Marketplace tile. I can get legal to provide a two-line approved statement.
evan: Important: recommend a default sampling strategy in the runbook (e.g., head-based 10% + 100% on errors) so customers don't blow up Datadog ingestion. Add config snippet with tail-based sampling note.
omar: Draft OTEL collector snippet: ```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  batch: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: "<DATADOG_KEY>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
matt: We'll need a small script to generate synthetic traces for the demo page. I can write a python generator that simulates 3 models at different latencies.
rachel: Can partnerships own the PR/blog outline? If so, marketing will finalize the co-authored post. Draft needed by Apr 12.
ana: ana: Partnerships will draft. Ill draft bullets and hand to marketing.
sdk-bot: checklist template for marketplace integrations pasted: install guide, dashboard json, marketing blurb, legal text, tracking params.
evan: Tracking params suggestion for UTM and internal funnel: utm_source=datadog&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=observability-bundle and rdw_partner=datadog.
matt: Quick question: do we enable auto-import of dashboard panels or require users to import JSON? Datadog supports both but marketplace tiles often point to import JSON. Prefer import JSON + one-click dashboard link.
omar: Also include instructions for self-hosted/private deployments: show how to forward traces from customer OTEL collector to Redwood hosted ingestion for hosted customers. Add note about redwood.model_id and redwood.customer_id tags for routing.
rachel: Marketing will need a hero screenshot (PNG 1200x600) + short GIF showing dashboard drilldown. Matt can own screenshots.
ana: ana: Can everyone add ETA to the checklist by EOD Friday? I'll compile and send to Datadog PM.
datadog-partner-bot: Datadog PM confirmed review window: Apr 15-19. Partner workspace doc uploaded: https://partners.datadog/rdw-observability-bundle
matt: I'll upload dashboard JSON + screenshot by Apr 10. Evan will upload sample app + otel config by Apr 9.
omar: I'll prepare a short runbook (install steps, recommended tags, sampling config, troubleshooting tips) and open a PR on docs repo.
evan: One more ops note: include a retention/ingestion estimate so customers understand cost. Add a small table in the runbook with example volumes and estimated Datadog ingestion cost.
rachel: Great. I'll schedule a marketing review session next Tue.
ana: Thanks all 1: I'll send a consolidated task list to the Datadog PM after you add ETAs.
ana: end
